body.name: \(\Theta_n\)
body.construction:
Let \(G_n=\{j/(64n^2):j=0,\ldots,n^2\}\) and \(C_n=\{j/(8n^2):j=n^2,\ldots,2n^2\}\). Then \(\Theta_n\) is the finite set of tuples \(	heta=(M_{\mathrm{mix}},\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}},q_e,q_b,q_	au,K,(w_\ell,u_\ell)_{\ell=1}^K)\) such that \(M_{\mathrm{mix}}\in\{1,\ldots,n^2\}\), \(\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}}\in C_n\), \((q_e,q_b,q_	au)\in G_n^3\), and \(
u_	heta=\sum_{\ell=1}^K w_\ell\delta_{u_\ell}\in\mathcal N_n(q_e)\). Impose the existing collar and smoothness restrictions \[q_e\le\min\{1/64,L[(1-2\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}})/M_{\mathrm{mix}}]^\alpha/64\},\quad q_b\le\min\{1/64,L[(1-2\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}})/M_{\mathrm{mix}}]^ eta/64\},\] \[q_	au\le\min\{1/64,L[(1-2\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}})/M_{\mathrm{mix}}]^\gamma/64\},\quad A_	heta=q_e+q_b+q_	au+3b_
u(	heta)\le1/32.\] The moment identities \(\zeta_r(	heta)=\mathbb E_{
u_	heta}[Z^r]=\sum_{\ell=1}^K w_\ell u_\ell^r\) for \(r=2,3,4\) are derived from this same atomic law, and \(\zeta_2(	heta)=q_e^2\), hence \(R_2(	heta)=0\), is automatic. The tuple \(M_{\mathrm{mix}}=1\), \(\kappa_{\mathrm{mix}}=1/8\), \(q_e=q_b=q_	au=0\), \(K=1\), \(w_1=1\), and \(u_1=0\) uses \(\delta_0\) and is included only to establish nonempty feasibility of the deterministic mixture optimization.
